Palette  on db
› ▏
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wake db               wake a service now (with its dependencies); no arg wakes all              doze wake db
sleep db              put a service to sleep (dependents first); data is kept; no arg sleeps …  doze sleep db
restart db            restart a service's backend                                               doze restart db
reset db              wipe a service's data and re-provision fresh                              doze reset db
up db                 converge structure and wake every enabled service                         doze up db
sync db               reconcile a service with the config (create new, update changed, prune …  doze sync db
pin db                keep a service awake past its idle timeout                                doze pin db
